answer_1.question: In Hollow Knight the big mantis guys in the tall arena keep beating me, any tips
answer_1.log_line: [09:53:01] ask_ollama: budget ... carried=22 turns ... earlier answers left out=False
answer_1.text:
Listen up, mate, these Mantis guys ain't just some random thugs you gotta run into. This is a proper dance, yeah? You gotta get your head right before you step into that arena. The main thing is to lock in that dodge-and-weave rhythm.
You need to learn the beat of their attacks - the lance dash, the drops from above, and especially that spinning boomerang blade. Think of it like a dance, yeah? If you can keep up with the timing, you'll be swinging those weapons back at 'em before they can get you.
Keep your eyes peeled for those openings, yeah?

answer_2.question: Hades the three sisters in the second area are wrecking me, help
answer_2.log_line: [09:53:51] ask_ollama: budget ... carried=12 turns ... earlier answers left out=True
answer_2.text:
Listen up, you're stuck with the three sisters in the second area, eh? Don't just stand there like a statue, you gotta get your head on the game! You need to learn their moves, yeah? Pay attention to how they dash - that's key. You gotta learn those dash patterns so you can punish 'em when they're recovering. Don't let 'em get away with the easy stuff.

And listen, when you're trying to burst 'em, you gotta use those mirror and trap boons. That's how you get that big hit and take 'em out quick. Get sharp, keep your eyes peeled, and you'll be kicking those sisters' backside before you know it. Now get out there and show 'em what you got!
